## Definition
A mechanism where wavefunction amplitudes cancel exactly at certain sites due to phase relationships imposed by the graph's local topology, leading to localization. This provides a physical principle for creating isolated computational states in a network without external potentials, enabling low-energy, topology-driven computing primitives.
